purpose: Show someone overcoming an obstacle without being deterred.
keywords: N + をものともせず（に）
The athlete kept running undeterred by the strong wind.
She pursued reform undeterred by criticism.
He made friends despite the language barrier.
formation: N + をものともせず（に）
restrictions: Usually admires persistence despite a real obstacle.
mistake: The obstacle is disregarded as a deterrent, not denied to exist.
